messages:
Alex J: EOD async — quick standup on audits / vuln remediation / IAM/KMS tasks. What I did: ran the weekly compliance checklist and kicked off a KMS rotation dry-run in staging. Blockers: scanner found 2 low-severity issues, and the dry-run hit a 409 on key import. Today: triage findings, get PRs merged, coordinate infra window for final rotation.

Samir: Saw the scanner alerts. I opened a fix for an overly-broad iam:PassRole on infra-deployer (PR #4821). @Cheng L can you review when you get a sec?

Cheng L: Will review now. Quick note on the KMS dry-run — import step failed with a 409 conflict (already exists). Log snippet:
```
2025-07-14T03:12:09Z ERROR kms: import-key failed status=409 key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod
```
I think the key version was left behind from the previous dry-run, will attempt cleanup and retry.

sec-bot: nightly-scan completed — 2 low (CVE-2024-2099, CVE-2024-2101), 0 medium/high. Scan report: https://redwood.internal/scans/1749991234 (auth required).

Maria K: Thanks @Samir. Pinged on the PR — suggestion: add an IAM condition to limit PassRole to the ci-bot service account to reduce blast radius. Low risk, small change.

Jamie: Scheduling infra window to finalize KMS rotation: tomorrow 09:00-10:00 PT. Can the owners confirm? I'll lock the calendar and notify SRE.

Alex J: Confirmed for 09:00 PT. For the dry-run retry, use this command to clean up stray key versions before re-import: `gcloud kms keys versions destroy --key=redwood-key --location=global --keyring=staging --version=all --quiet` (run in staging only).

Cheng L: Reviewed @Samir's PR, left 2 nits around logging. Approve after CI passes. Also cleaned the stray key versions and retried import — succeeded this time.

Samir: Thanks — merging after tests. Marking the blocker from scanner as "in progress" -> "resolved" once deploy goes out.

Alex J: Updated the rotation checklist doc and added the retry step + cleanup command: https://go/doc/kms-rotation-checklist. Closing my loop for today. Thx everyone :thumbsup:
